articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
articles.description: The platform tracks tokenized securities ownership and transfers, linking to Malaysia’s RENTAS+ system to settle corresponding payments in central bank money.

articles.title: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
articles.description: A private key generation flaw allowed anyone to guess them and forge HTTPS certificates for any website.

articles.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
articles.description: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.

articles.title: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
articles.description: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

articles.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
articles.description: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

articles.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
articles.description: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

articles.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
articles.description: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

articles.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.

articles.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
articles.description: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.description: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

articles.title: Alphabet, Microsoft add objections to OKX-ICE proposed tokenized stock platform
articles.description: About 25% of the US-listed companies in OKXICE’s initial tokenized stock platform proposal are asking to opt-out of the venture.

articles.title: Bitcoin price spikes to $83.3K as US stocks rise on Q3 earnings, oil falls
articles.description: High US corporate earnings reports boosted stock markets and saw BTC price hit $83,300 before reversing at a 21-day trend line.

articles.title: Agents can trade 24/7 — but Yat Siu warns you could lose access at any time
articles.description: The Animoca Brands chairman explains that AI agents can make trades while you sleep, but users need to plan for the day they lose access to the bots.

articles.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
articles.description: The Swiss regulator cited a growing appetite for cryptocurrency investments and said that multiple fund providers have submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.

articles.title: Drift exploiter sends $61M ETH to Tornado Cash, holds $194M
articles.description: The April 1 hack caused about $295 million in losses and was later attributed to a North Korean threat group in a Mandiant investigation.

articles.title: Tx launches USTX stablecoin to pull RWA liquidity onto its chain
articles.description: The Brale-issued token can be minted with USDC from eight networks and is designed to settle tokenized stocks and other assets on tx.

articles.title: Lloyds and Barclays among UK banks named in crypto transfer complaints, advocacy group says
articles.description: UK banks are facing scrutiny over crypto transfer limits and bans as Stand With Crypto reports thousands of complaints ahead of the country’s 2027 regulatory regime.

articles.title: Netflix FTX trailer was ‘enough to upset me’ in first 30 seconds: former FTX COO
articles.description: Constance Wang criticized the streamer’s portrayal of her former FTX colleagues as not matching her own experience with Sam Bankman-Fried and Caroline Ellison.

articles.title: Kazakhstan court orders curbs on Coinbase, BingX and four others
articles.description: Nine other crypto platforms voluntarily restricted app access in Kazakhstan, prompting the regulator to withdraw its claims against them.

articles.title: XRP 30-day exchange inflows pass 6B tokens as whales move to the sidelines
articles.description: More than 6 billion XRP reached exchanges tracked by CryptoQuant in the 30 days to Oct. 19, the most since March.

articles.title: Mt. Gox pushes creditor repayment deadline to 2027 in sixth extension
articles.description: Mt. Gox extended its repayment deadline by another year as some creditors remain unpaid due to incomplete procedures and payment processing issues.

articles.title: Bitget plans Thai crypto exchange acquisition weeks after $388M hack
articles.description: The proposed acquisition would give Bitget a route into Thailand’s crypto market through a locally licensed operator.

articles.title: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
articles.description: JPMorgan included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market outlook for the first time but warned that volatility and unstable correlations limit its role in investment portfolios.

articles.title: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
articles.description: BlackRock’s proposed Bitcoin fund would use options to limit potential losses and gains, adding another strategy to its existing Bitcoin and Ether ETF lineup.

articles.title: US Bitcoin ETFs draw $527M in biggest showing since September
articles.description: BlackRock’s IBIT led the gains with $665.2 million in inflows, offsetting withdrawals from Fidelity and Grayscale, while other funds recorded no net flows.

articles.title: Sophon sets Nov. 25 withdrawal deadline ahead of mainnet shutdown
articles.description: In June, Sophon’s developers said the costs of maintaining a standalone blockchain no longer justified its benefits and announced plans to focus on consumer finance and AI applications on Base.

articles.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
articles.description: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

articles.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
articles.description: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

articles.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
articles.description: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.
